scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to MSEs for Shed Developed by Private Developer
other_conditions: The firm must be a Micro, Small or Medium Enterprise (MSE)
The shed must be located in a government‑approved mini estate
The entrepreneur must pay 30% of the shed cost to acquire possession
SC/ST enterprise means the SC/ST entrepreneur contributes 51% or more to the enterprise
benefits_summary: Provides 15% additional financial assistance to private developers and requires SC/ST entrepreneurs to pay only 30% of the shed cost, with the government disbursing the remaining amounts in stages.
